description: Cancel lands and never deletes (D7): the row stays, `list` still shows it, and the status reads `cancelled` — the off-ramp R1 allows from every pre-loop rung. Note what cancel CANNOT do in this slice: a `running` item refuses (its loop is the loop's own record — the loop verbs stop it; the refusal fixture `refused.json` shows that answer). The item's fields are untouched beside the status: the estimate, the pointers, the provenance all still read what they read before.
